hints.title: Subtree Apple Contribution
hints.text: For any subtree rooted at node u, traversal is required if u itself has an apple or any child subtree contains an apple.

hints.title: Edge Traversal Cost
hints.text: Traversing to a child and returning to u costs 2 seconds. Add 2 to the subtree cost for each child subtree that contains an apple.

hints.title: Exclude Root Traversal Cost
hints.text: The root node 0 does not require traversal to reach itself, so only sum edge costs from internal branches.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of vertices in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Visiting vertices without aggregating subtree apple presence repeats paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A postorder traversal passes apple presence upwards in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses bottom-up tree search to sum round-trip edge costs only for apple-bearing subtrees.
complexity.notes: Round trip per valid branch adds 2.

solutions.approach: bottom-up tree search aggregating round-trip edge times
